wholePhysicalScope: The named OSM roof outline and the four distinct corner building perimeters constrain the whole site. Firsthand CC0 photographs control the facade proportions and foreground structures.
lodDetails: Four levels preserve the flared central hall, courtyard and four corner annexes.
limitations: The central roof opening, floor heights, later landscaping and parts of the two rear annexes are proportional interpretations. Individual column carvings are simplified. The neighboring natural history building is a separate structure.
